title.title: The Quiz with Balls
title.overview: Hosted by comedian Jay Pharoah, families must work together as each contestant faces a quiz where each wrong answer results in a massive ball rapidly descending and knocking them into a pool below; the final dry family member plays the final round for a $100,000 grand prize.

episodes.name: First Responders Face-off
episodes.overview: Tonight, it's Firefighters vs. Nurses in a frontline frenzy! Firefighters and nurses, heroes on any given day, leave duty behind and take on the balls. They're saving nothing tonight - except their own shot at $100,000 in bragging rights glory as they go head-to-head to see who has what it takes to stay dry and conquer The Quiz With Balls!

episodes.name: Battle of the Viral Sensations
episodes.overview: The Skorys and the Sharpes, viral internet stars, compete in a massive showdown. It's the biggest competition of their lives, with one crew winning $100,000.

episodes.name: Football Rivals
episodes.overview: Two opposing teams: Bills vs Vikings, get their redemption arc as the ultimate underdogs of the NFL. Today, these teams ditch the heartbreak of losing and take total control of the scoreboard. These fans will do whatever it takes to walk away to win the bragging rights their teams never gave them. With $100,000 and the title of the dominant underdogs on the line, hungry fans go head-to-head.

episodes.name: Lifeguards vs. Beauty Queens
episodes.overview: It is beauty against brawn with the Lifeguards vs. Beauty Queens! The ladies are known for their beauty but also their brains and know a thing or two about competition while the lifeguards are no strangers to big splashes! There is not a weak one among them, and they will duke it out for $100,000 and go head-to-head.

episodes.name: Marines vs. Air Force
episodes.overview: Today we celebrate the greatest country in the world with a six-ball salute! To say thank you to all the men and women that serve our country we have a patriotic rivalry of the Marine Men vs. the Winged Women of the Air Force who will be competing for the chance to win $100,000.

episodes.name: Soccer Showdown
episodes.overview: Team USA fans take on Team England fans for the chance to win $100,000 while going head-to-head against the balls.

episodes.name: Harlem Globetrotters vs. Washington Generals
episodes.overview: Tonight, the best ball handlers on earth who have been doing it for 100 years, the world famous Harlem Globetrotters are once again up against the Washington Generals, who have not won a game since 1971. It is time to see if history will repeat itself as the two teams compete for the chance to win $100,000.

episodes.name: Hunters vs. Vegetarians
episodes.overview: Tonight, it's the Hunters vs. Vegetarians on the hunt for the $100,000 prize.
